summary: Shelf Keeper: Track your personal book collection and who has borrowed each book, so you always know what's out and what's home.
implemented_features: Add a book to the collection
View all books in one list
Filter to books currently lent out
See how many books are lent out right now
assumptions: Built for A single user managing their home library on their own computer..
Persistence decision: Browser localStorage under key 'shelf-keeper-books'; load with malformed-data recovery, save on every mutation.

tests_run.journey: Generated journey suite passed: Add a book, see it in the list as available, refresh, and confirm it persists; Lend a book to someone, filter to lent-only, confirm it appears and the lent count increments; Return a book, confirm it leaves the lent-only filter and the count decrements; Edit a book's title and genre, confirm the change persists after refresh; Delete a mistakenly added book, confirm it is gone from the list and counts update

harness_checks.journey: The generated app's Vitest report contained at least one completed test and no failed, skipped, or todo tests
The generated app completed a production build
The generated app started its own HTTP server on port 3000 and shut down cleanly
